correctness.rationale: Direct algebra confirms the theorem. Coordinatewise multiplication annihilates the three displayed determinantal quadrics; on x0 nonzero they solve as x2/x0=t^2 and x4/x0=2rt, giving a birational affine plane. The source sections have the unique projective base point ([1:1],[0:1]); in local coordinates their ideal is generated by u and t, so the point is simple and the exceptional divisor maps by the independent linear terms to the ruling line. The fiber z0=0 is contracted, while y0=y1 maps to the directrix. The resolved moving class is pullback of (1,2) minus E, whose square is 4-1=3. The inspected symbolic verifier independently checks the polynomial identities, all source charts, projective smoothness, local sections, and distinguished fibers.
